salt-water.label: Level 40: spare Amulet of Slow Digestion and a Potion of Salt Water
salt-water.explanation: Original: the Salt Water counts as worth 300,000 gold, so the Borg drops the amulet (worth 200 gold). Corrected: the Salt Water counts as worth nothing and is dropped.

PACK b Potion of Salt Water value=0 weight=4
PACK c Amulet of Slow Digestion value=200 weight=3

TRACK # Dropping Amulet of Slow Digestion.
